user.title: Connect to KlipperKiosk
user.description: Enter your tablet's hostname or IP address and Settings PIN (default: 1234).

zeroconf_confirm.title: Discovered KlipperKiosk tablet
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found KlipperKiosk at {host}:{port}. Enter the tablet's Settings PIN to finish setup.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate KlipperKiosk
reauth_confirm.description: The Settings PIN for {host} was rejected. Enter the updated PIN.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure KlipperKiosk
reconfigure.description: Update the connection details for your KlipperKiosk tablet.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the KlipperKiosk tablet. Check the host, port, and network.

abort.already_configured: This KlipperKiosk tablet is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the discovered device.
abort.not_klipperkiosk: The discovered device is not running KlipperKiosk.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The new host and port do not match the configured device.

add_tab.name: Add tab
add_tab.description: Add a new tab to the KlipperKiosk tablet.

url.name: URL
url.description: Target URL or .local hostname (http:// is prepended automatically if omitted).

title.name: Title
title.description: Optional label shown in the tab strip.

activate.name: Activate
activate.description: Immediately switch to the newly added tab.

update_tab.name: Update tab
update_tab.description: Update an existing tab's title and/or URL.

tab_id.name: Tab ID
tab_id.description: ID of the tab to update (see the Active tab entity's tabs attribute).

delete_tab.name: Delete tab
delete_tab.description: Delete a tab by ID. If active, the kiosk switches to the first remaining tab.

tab_id.name: Tab ID
tab_id.description: ID of the tab to delete.

activate_tab.name: Activate tab
activate_tab.description: Switch the kiosk to a specific tab by ID.

tab_id.name: Tab ID
tab_id.description: ID of the tab to activate.

reorder_tabs.name: Reorder tabs
reorder_tabs.description: Reorder the top tab strip by providing an ordered list of tab IDs.

ids.name: Tab IDs
ids.description: Ordered list of tab IDs. Any omitted existing tabs are appended at the end.

navigate.name: Navigate
navigate.description: Load a temporary URL in the active WebView without modifying the saved tab list.

url.name: URL
url.description: URL to open temporarily in the active view.

set_pin.name: Change PIN
set_pin.description: Change the Settings PIN on the tablet and update Home Assistant's stored PIN.

pin.name: New PIN
pin.description: New PIN for both the on-device Settings dialog and the Remote API.

send_ir.name: Transmit IR signal
send_ir.description: Transmit an infrared pulse pattern (raw microseconds or Pronto Hex) via the tablet's built-in IR blaster.

frequency.name: Carrier frequency
frequency.description: Carrier frequency in Hz (10000-100000) for raw patterns. Ignored when pronto_hex is used.

pattern.name: Raw pattern (microseconds)
pattern.description: List of alternating ON/OFF pulse durations in microseconds.

pronto_hex.name: Pronto Hex
pronto_hex.description: Pronto Hex IR code string (alternative to raw pattern).

repeat.name: Repeat count
repeat.description: Number of times to transmit the IR signal (1-10).
